content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

At its core, COREMERCH offers a range of sovereign digital commerce stacks that enable creators like you to sell digital products, such as Notion templates, ebooks, and courses, without relying on third-party payment processors like PayPal or Stripe. This means you get to keep 100% of your sales, without being subject to the 10% fees and account restrictions that come with using traditional payment gateways. By deploying your own digital commerce stack, you're not only saving money, but also gaining full control over your sales data and customer relationships.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Each COREMERCH stack is carefully designed to work seamlessly with NOWPayments, a leading cryptocurrency payment processor that charges a flat 0.5% fee on every sale. By integrating your digital products with NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin and USDT, and send automatic payment confirmations to your customers. Meanwhile, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle order processing and delivery, ensuring that your customers receive their digital products instantly, without any manual intervention.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH is built specifically for creators in regions where traditional payment processors are restricted or unavailable. Whether you're a Notion template creator in Nigeria, a course instructor in Kenya, or an ebook author in Pakistan, our sovereign digital commerce stacks are designed to help you overcome the challenges of selling digital products in a restrictive payment environment. By choosing COREMERCH, you're joining a community of like-minded creators who are tired of being held back by traditional payment processors and are ready to take control of their digital commerce infrastructure.
You can deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack with COREMERCH starting at just $197.
The Components That Make It Work Together

At COREMERCH, we believe in a modular approach to digital commerce infrastructure. Our stacks are built from a range of free and open-source components, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. By integrating these components, we create a seamless and efficient digital commerce experience that's tailored to your specific needs and goals. Whether you're just starting out or scaling your business, our sovereign digital commerce stacks have got you covered.
